Article Text:

NEW DELHI: India's star wicketkeeper batter Rishabh Pant created history on Tuesday during the first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle. The India wicketkeeper-batter became the first Indian cricketer to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket.Pant reached the milestone with a big six off Lahiru Kumara. The shot also brought up his 20th Test fifty.Pant became only the fourth batter in Test history to hit 100 sixes. Ben Stokes leads the list with 138 sixes, followed by Brendon McCullum with 107. Pant is now third with 100 sixes, while former Australia wicketkeeper Adam Gilchrist also has 100.Pant reached the landmark in his aggressive style against Kumara. The Sri Lankan pacer bowled a delivery on a length and angled it into the left-hander. Pant got inside the line and pulled it over long leg.Nuwantha tried to catch the ball but could only watch it sail over the boundary.The six also brought up Pant's fifty, his 20th in Test cricket.With the shot, Pant became the first Indian and only the fourth batter overall to reach 100 sixes in Test cricket.
Article Summary: Rishabh pant becomes the first indian cricketer to hit 100 sixes in test cricket. Pant reached the milestone with a big six off lahiru kumara. The shot also brought up his 20th test fifty. Ben stokes leads the list with 138 sixes, followed by brendon mccullum with 107.

Article Title: NBA trade news: Cleveland Cavaliers secure $88 million star in 5-team trade
Article Text:

Cavaliers land Peyton Watson in trade that sends Max Strus away

How does the 5-team trade look?

What the trade means for each team

Peyton Watson's restricted free agency finally has an ending, and it isn't the one Denver wanted. The Nuggets are sending their 23-year-old forward to Cleveland in a sign-and-trade that also pulls in the Clippers, Wizards and Kings, closing a standoff that dragged through the entire offseason.The Cavaliers gave up Max Strus to create the cap room, then locked Watson into a four-year, $88 million contract carrying a player option and trade kicker. In a separate but connected move, Cleveland shipped Tre Mann and a 2027 second-rounder to Washington for Cam Whitmore, with the Wizards forwarding center Julian Reese to Denver, who will waive him.Peyton Watson steps into a starting five that already runs through Mitchell, Harden, Mobley and Allen, giving Cleveland a projected lineup among the East's best on paper. He replaces a rotation piece in Strus and instantly becomes a younger, longer option at small forward.ESPN’s Shams Charania wrote on X, “BREAKING: Cleveland, Denver and the Clippers have agreed on a trade sending Peyton Watson to the Cavaliers, Max Strus to LA, and an unprotected 2031 Cavs first-round pick and a 2032 Kings second-rounder to the Nuggets, sources tell ESPN. Watson will sign a new four-year, $88 million deal to join the Cavaliers, plus a player option and a trade kicker.”The move caps a saga that started building in April, when Bobby Marks reported the Los Angeles Lakers, Chicago Bulls and Brooklyn Nets were all potential landing spots for Watson. His market grew once teams realized how thin the 2026 free-agent class was beyond him, with Jalen Duren also unproven and LeBron James and Harden both past their prime as long-term bets.Denver's return is entirely draft capital: an unprotected 2031 Cavaliers first-round pick and a 2032 Kings second-rounder that Sacramento previously owed Cleveland. The Wizards and Kings both play supporting roles, absorbing and forwarding pieces so the money and picks land where they need to. Cleveland's side of the ledger includes both incoming (Watson, Whitmore) and outgoing (Strus, Mann) pieces, structured to keep the sign-and-trade workable under the tax rules.ESPN's Bobby Marks laid out Cleveland's math afterward, noting the sign-and-trade hard-caps the Cavaliers at the first apron and that they sit "roughly $29M below the first apron" before re-signing Harden, who remains technically unsigned on a reported "wink-wink" agreement.For Denver, there's no easy replacement for Watson's two-way impact. He posted career-highs across the board in 2025-26: 14.6 points, 4.9 rebounds, a 59.4 true shooting percentage and a jump from 35.3 to 41.1 percent from three, all before a hamstring injury cut his season short at 54 games.The next checkpoint is Harden. Cleveland's cap sheet only fully clarifies once his new deal is finalized, and that number will determine how much flexibility the Cavaliers actually have left this summer.
Article Summary: Peyton watson's restricted free agency finally has an ending, and it isn't the one denver wanted. The nuggets are sending their 23-year-old forward to cleveland in a sign-and-trade that also pulls in the clippers, wizards and kings. The cavaliers gave up max strus to create the cap room, then locked watson into a four-year, $88 million contract.

Article Title: Inspiring story of the day: “I was in a really dark place. My family and my inner circle saved my life” - How Nick Kyrgios turned mental health battles and family love into tennis redemption
Article Text:
Inspiring story of the day: “I was in a really dark place. My family and my inner circle saved my life” - How Nick Kyrgios turned mental health battles and family love into tennis redemption

How did Nick Kyrgios reach his darkest point in 2019

How did Nick Kyrgios’ family help him through his mental health battle

How did Nick Kyrgios turn his struggles into tennis success

What does Nick Kyrgios’ latest setback mean for his journey

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Nick Kyrgios has never had a simple relationship with tennis. The Australian star has spoken openly about depression, self-harm, alcohol and drug use, and a period in 2019 when he was struggling to see a way forward. His family and close friends became an important part of his recovery. That journey later led him to an Australian Open doubles title and the Wimbledon singles final in 2022. But Kyrgios’ story is still unfolding. In August 2026, he was provisionally suspended after testing positive for cocaine, once again putting his mental health and personal struggles in focus.Kyrgios was already a major name in tennis when he began struggling badly with his mental health. His breakthrough had come at Wimbledon in 2014, when the 19-year-old wildcard beat Rafael Nadal in one of the biggest wins of his young career.The attention grew quickly after that. Kyrgios became known for his huge serve, unusual shot-making and emotional behaviour on court. He was also under constant pressure to live up to his talent.By 2019, he said he was not coping well with that pressure. In an interview later published about his struggles, Kyrgios described that period as one of the lowest points of his life.“2019 was the lowest point of my career. That pressure, having all eyes on you, the expectation, I couldn’t deal with it.”He also spoke about drinking, drug use, pushing away people close to him and hurting himself. After losing at Wimbledon that year, he returned to his hotel and found his father crying beside him. Kyrgios later said that moment made him realise that he could not continue living in the same way.He eventually went to a psychiatric ward in London. He later explained that doctors wanted him to stay for two weeks so his condition could be assessed.For someone who had spent years being seen mainly through his behaviour on a tennis court, admitting how badly he was struggling was a major change.In 2022, Kyrgios also wrote about that period on Instagram, saying he had been lonely, depressed and struggling to get out of bed while still having to play in front of millions of people. The Guardian reported his comments at the time.Kyrgios has repeatedly spoken about the importance of his family and the people closest to him. His struggles became worse when he began shutting them out, something he later recognised as part of the problem.His father, Giorgos, was with him during the difficult period in 2019. That night after the Wimbledon defeat became especially important because seeing his father break down forced Kyrgios to look at what was happening to him.“I lost at Wimbledon, I woke up and my dad was just sitting next to me on the bed and he was like full-blown crying. That was a bit wake-up call for me. I was like, okay, I cannot keep doing this.”His relationship with his family has remained a major part of how he talks about his life away from tennis.Kyrgios has also spoken about how difficult fame was for his family when his career suddenly took off. In an interview with Ed Mylett, he explained that he and his family came from a quiet area in Canberra and were not wealthy. Success changed their lives quickly, and he said they were not prepared for that level of attention.He also said that spending more time with his family during injury breaks helped him understand how much he had missed them while travelling around the tennis world.That support became even more important as Kyrgios dealt with injuries and the long periods away from competition that followed his biggest season.The clearest sign that Kyrgios had found a better balance came in 2022.He teamed up with his childhood friend Thanasi Kokkinakis at the Australian Open. The pair entered the men’s doubles tournament as wildcards and went on to win the title, beating fellow Australians Matthew Ebden and Max Purcell in the final. It was the first Australian men’s doubles title at the tournament since 1997.Only months later, Kyrgios reached the Wimbledon singles final.That run was one of the biggest achievements of his career. He beat several strong opponents before meeting Novak Djokovic in the final. Kyrgios won the opening set but Djokovic came back to win 4-6, 6-3, 6-4, 7-6(3).The result still marked a major change for Kyrgios. He had gone from speaking publicly about suicidal thoughts and severe mental health struggles to playing in his first Grand Slam singles final.After the final, Kyrgios spoke about the pressure he had felt throughout the tournament.“It’s just a lot mentally. Everyone’s supporting you. There are negative comments. Like the pressure of playing finals at Wimbledon.”He also described the strange feeling of being on Centre Court after everything he had experienced.“I’m just not supposed to be here. Like, I’m a kid from Canberra.”Those words captured why his Wimbledon run meant more than simply reaching a final. It showed how much his life had changed.Kyrgios’ story cannot be described as a straight line from struggle to recovery. His recent years have included serious injuries, limited time on court and renewed personal difficulties.In August 2026, the International Tennis Integrity Agency provisionally suspended him after he tested positive for cocaine at an ATP tournament in Mallorca in June. The substance found in his sample was benzoylecgonine, a metabolite of cocaine. Kyrgios accepted responsibility and said he had made a “huge mistake”.He linked the episode to the physical and mental strain caused by years of injuries and uncertainty over his tennis future. He also announced a 28-day break from social media and public life to focus on his well-being.That latest chapter does not erase what Kyrgios achieved in 2022, nor does it make his earlier openness about mental health less important. It does, however, show that recovery is not always a straight path.Kyrgios has spent much of his career being judged for what people see on the court. His own accounts have shown that there was always much more happening away from it. His willingness to talk about depression, self-harm, substance use and the role of his family has given fans a different way to understand him.His tennis story includes a Wimbledon final and a Grand Slam doubles title. His personal story is more complicated. It is about asking for help, accepting support, falling back into difficult places and trying to find a way forward again.
Article Summary: Tennis star nick kyrgios was struggling with mental health in 2019. The 19-year-old went to a psychiatric ward after losing at wimbledon. His family and close friends became an important part of his recovery. That journey later led him to an australian open doubles title and the wimbledon singles final in 2022.

Article Title: Jason Kelce’s broadcasting career could take an unexpected turn as NFL Network considers him for select game broadcasts
Article Text:

Jason Kelce could join NFL Network games

Why Jason Kelce’s NFL Network role could be significant

Jason Kelce may be adding another role to his growing television career. The former Philadelphia Eagles center could soon move from ESPN’s studio coverage to the NFL Network booth for select regular-season games, according to a new report. No agreement is final yet, but the possibility gives Kelce another chance to bring his outspoken personality and football insight directly to live game coverage.ESPN is reportedly working to finalize broadcast teams for seven NFL Network games during the 2026 regular season. The expected booths currently include Dave Pasch with Kurt Warner and Bob Wichusen with Louis Riddick. However, Jason Kelce could become part of the lineup for some of those broadcasts.Ryan Glasspiegel of Front Office Sports reported that Kelce’s potential assignment is still “fluid” and that no decision has been made.That detail matters because Kelce has already become one of ESPN’s most recognizable football personalities since joining the network. His work has mostly centered on the Monday Night Football pregame show, where his relaxed style and willingness to speak candidly have helped him stand out.A move into live game commentary would give Kelce a different platform. Instead of breaking down a game before kickoff, he could be reacting to plays as they unfold, explaining blocking schemes, offensive decisions and the small details that casual viewers may miss.Kelce’s playing career also gives him a perspective that can be difficult to replicate. He spent 13 seasons as an NFL center with the Eagles and became one of the league’s most respected offensive linemen before retiring after the 2023 season.The NFL Network schedule creates an interesting opportunity for Kelce. Five of the seven games are part of the league’s early-morning European package, with contests scheduled for London, France and Madrid. The NFL has not yet packaged and sold those games to the highest bidder.The remaining two games will be played domestically on Saturday, December 26.If Kelce receives an assignment, the decision could also reflect how quickly his broadcasting career has expanded. He has already taken on projects beyond traditional sports analysis, including a five-episode run as a late-night host.That versatility could make him particularly useful for a broadcast schedule that reaches audiences in different markets. Kelce can offer technical football analysis without losing the conversational quality that has become central to his television persona.Still, nothing is settled. The report makes clear that Kelce’s role remains undecided, meaning the final NFL Network booths could look different once ESPN completes its plans.For now, the possibility alone adds another intriguing chapter to Jason Kelce’s post-NFL career. The former Eagles star has already proven he can command attention away from the field. A spot in the booth would give him another opportunity to show whether that appeal can translate to live NFL game coverage.
Article Summary: Espn is reportedly working to finalize broadcast teams for seven nfl network games during the 2026 regular season. The expected booths currently include dave pasch with kurt warner and bob wichusen with louis riddick. No agreement is final yet, but the possibility gives kelce another chance to bring his outspoken personality and football insight directly to live game coverage.

Article Title: Not James Anderson or Stuart Broad: Ollie Robinson pulls off a first in England Test history
Article Text:
England's Ollie Robinson celebrates bowling out Pakistan's Azan Awais on day one of the first Test match between England and Pakistan in Leeds, England, Wednesday, Aug. 19, 2026

Full list: Wickets to fall on the first ball of a Test series

Bowler Batter Venue Year Test Badcock (NZ) Herbert Sutcliffe (ENG) Christchurch 1933 Ernie McCormick (AUS) Stan Worthington (ENG) The Gabba 1936 Kapil Dev (IND) Jimmy Cook (SA) Durban 1992 Pedro Collins (WI) Hannan Sarkar (BAN) Dhaka 2002 Pedro Collins (WI) Hannan Sarkar (BAN) Gros Islet 2004 Mashrafe Mortaza (BAN) Wasim Jaffer (IND) Chattogram 2007 Mohammad Amir (PAK) Tim McIntosh (NZ) Dunedin 2009 Suranga Lakmal (SL) KL Rahul (IND) Eden Gardens 2017 James Anderson (ENG) Dean Elgar (SA) Centurion 2019 Blessing Muzarabani (ZIM) Abdul Malik (AFG) Abu Dhabi 2021 Mitchell Starc (AUS) Rory Burns (ENG) The Gabba 2021 Ollie Robinson (ENG) Azan Awais (PAK) Headingley 2026

Ollie Robinson gave England the start they wanted in the first Test of Joe Root 's second spell as Test captain, dismissing Pakistan opener Awais Ali for a golden duck with the very first ball of the series at Headingley.Robinson trapped Awais lbw with the first delivery of the match. Awais reviewed the decision, hoping the ball had pitched outside the line, but the review returned three reds and the decision stayed.The fast bowler struck again in his opening spell, dismissing Pakistan captain Shan Masood in his third over to leave the visitors at 6-2.After 10 overs, rain forced the players off the field with Pakistan on 19-2.Robinson has now taken a wicket in the first over of a Test innings in back-to-back matches. During his return to England's Test side against New Zealand at Lord's earlier this summer, after more than two years out of the team, he picked up three wickets in his opening over. He finished that match with five wickets in New Zealand's first innings and two more in the second as England won by 115 runs.The wicket of Awais also put Robinson into the record books. It was the first time an England bowler had taken a wicket with the first ball of the opening Test of a series played in England.He also became only the second England bowler to dismiss a batter with the first ball of any Test series. James Anderson achieved the feat when he removed Dean Elgar with the first delivery of England's series against South Africa in Centurion in 2019.In Test cricket history, a wicket has fallen from the first ball of a series 12 times. West Indies fast bowler Pedro Collins is the only player to do it twice, dismissing Bangladesh opener Hannan Sarkar on both occasions, as per a report by Wisden.England's first Test under reappointed captain Joe Root continued to go their way on the opening day.Pakistan collapsed from 117-3 to 171 all out, with Robinson and Josh Tongue taking five wickets each.By stumps, England had reached 112-2, trailing Pakistan by 59 runs.

How could Sidney Crosby's extension affect Pittsburgh?

Sidney Crosby is believed to be in discussions with the Pittsburgh Penguins about a contract extension, and those talks are said to be expected before the 2026-27 NHL season, per reports. Crosby’s agent, Pat Brisson, told The Athletic’s Josh Yohe that an extension is expected to be discussed in the offseason.The development may offer more insight into the future of the Pittsburgh Penguins captain. Crosby is entering the final year of his current two-year contract, which carries an $8.7 million AAV and expires after the 2026-27 season.Sidney Crosby and the Pittsburgh Penguins are in a new extension against each other. Mostly before the start of the 2026-27 season. Crosby’s agent, Pat Brisson, said he expects to have a conversation about a contract with Pittsburgh before the end of the offseason.The last year of a two-year, $17.4 million extension Crosby signed with the Pittsburgh Penguins in September 2024. It carries an $8.7 million cap hit for each of the next four seasons, through 2026-27.The big thing about the 2024 agreement is that it kept Crosby with the franchise and with the same $8.7 million cap hit that was attached to his previous long-term deal. Pittsburgh Penguins president of hockey operations and general manager Kyle Dubas called Crosby’s decision a personal sacrifice to help the organization remain competitive.A new deal would keep one of the most important players in Pittsburgh Penguins history under contract past the 2026-27 season. Crosby has spent his entire NHL career withPittsburgh, winning three Stanley Cups with the club.It’s also notable timing, because Crosby previously indicated in May that his plans beyond 2026-27 weren’t settled. His philosophy, he said, was to look at his situation year by year, and not too far ahead.Keeping Crosby would allow the organization to develop its next generation of players while still having his scoring, leadership and experience. Pittsburgh returned to the Stanley Cup Playoffs in 2025-26, after missing the postseason for three straight years.The Penguins also have continued shuffling their veteran core. Evgeni Malkin signed a one-year extension through 2026-27. Tommy Novak signed a longer deal starting in 2027-28.Crosby’s next contract has not been publicly confirmed for any specific term, salary or signing date. The big news right now is that talks on an extension are expected, giving Pittsburgh Penguins fans solid reason to believe Crosby’s time in Pittsburgh could extend past his current deal.

Article Title: Khabib Nurmagomedov’s yet another old clip about Islam Makhachev’s potential goes viral, his 2018 warning to Gleison Tibau looks prophetic years later

Long before Islam Makhachev became a two-division UFC champion, Khabib Nurmagomedov was already convinced his teammate was special. In behind-the-scenes footage from 2018, Nurmagomedov issued a blunt warning ahead of Makhachev’s fight with Gleison Tibau.The throwback footage, shared by filmmaker Will Harris as part of, captured Nurmagomedov speaking about Makhachev before the Brazilian veteran faced him. Makhachev was still developing his reputation at the time. But Nurmagomedov believed he was already operating at a completely different level.Khabib Nurmagomedov’s comment came ahead of Islam Makhachev’s fifth UFC appearance. The Russian star was already highly respected for his wrestling and grappling. He also knew Makhachev better than most. The two trained together under Khabib’s late father and coach, Abdulmanap Nurmagomedov.That made Nurmagomedov’s prediction particularly interesting.Gleison Tibau was an experienced UFC veteran. He had fought some of the biggest names in the lightweight division. For a young Makhachev, the matchup represented another important step in his UFC career.Nurmagomedov, however, did not appear concerned.“Sorry Tibau, but Islam is different level, be careful brother”, he said in the viral clip.The message was simple. Nurmagomedov believed Makhachev’s skills were too advanced for Tibau.Makhachev then provided an emphatic answer inside the Octagon.At UFC 220, he stopped Tibau in just 57 seconds of the first round. The result was a knockout win and another major step forward in his career.At that stage, few could have known how far Makhachev would eventually go. The lightweight contender later became one of the most dominant fighters in UFC history.Makhachev won the vacant UFC lightweight championship at UFC 280 in 2022. He submitted Charles Oliveira to capture the title. He then successfully defended it four times.His success eventually took him into a second weight division.Makhachev moved up to welterweight and captured another UFC championship by defeating Jack Della Maddalena. He later defended the welterweight title against Ian Machado Garry at UFC 330.His run also saw him break the UFC record for consecutive victories. His winning streak reached 17 fights, moving him past Anderson Silva’s previous mark of 16 consecutive UFC wins.Nurmagomedov has remained one of Makhachev’s biggest supporters throughout the journey.After Makhachev reached the record, Khabib praised his longtime friend and teammate on social media.“There is a word : Achievement. In sport it has a great significance, Islam and the word Achievement are synonyms)))) he achieved great heights in this sport, broke the record of series wins in UFC history, and is rightfully one of the best athletes to ever enter the octagon. May the Almighty keep you well, brother”, he wrote.Another famous Khabib prediction also emerged from 2019. During UFC 242 fight week, he placed his lightweight championship belt in front of Makhachev and called him the “Future UFC champ.”At the time, Makhachev was still a rising contender.Today, those old clips carry a different meaning.Years later, Makhachev’s championships, record-breaking winning streak and continued dominance have made those words look remarkably accurate.

Article Title: Hockey World Cup: India extend dominance over Pakistan with 5-3 thriller, seal next-round spot
Article Text:
India beat Pakistan (Pic credit: Hockey India)

As it happened:

Harmanpreet, Abhishek put India in command

Pakistan fight back in goal-filled second quarter

Hardik restores three-goal cushion

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Pakistan threaten late, but India hold firm

NEW DELHI: India extended their dominance over arch-rivals Pakistan with a thrilling 5-3 victory in their final Pool D match of the FIH Men's Hockey World Cup on Wednesday, overcoming a spirited fightback to book their place in the next round.In a contest befitting one of hockey's biggest rivalries, India raced to a 3-0 lead before Pakistan repeatedly threatened a comeback. Harmanpreet Singh and Abhishek scored twice each, while Hardik Singh converted a penalty stroke as India maintained their grip on the contest.Pakistan fought back through Hannan Shahid's brace and Sufyan Khan's penalty-corner strike, but India held their nerve during a tense final quarter, including a spell when they were reduced to 10 players.India finished second in Pool D with six points from three matches, behind England, who topped the group with nine points. Pakistan were eliminated.India made a flying start and were rewarded with their first penalty corner in the fifth minute. Harmanpreet's initial drag-flick struck a Pakistan defender's foot, but the India captain got another opportunity and made no mistake.He kept his second effort low and hard towards the goalkeeper's left, beating the post defender to put India ahead.India doubled their advantage in the 11th minute. Abhishek showed excellent control to bring down an aerial ball before playing it across goal, with the ball eventually finding the net off a Pakistan stick. The goal was initially credited to Mandeep Singh during the live action, but the FIH website later credited it to Abhishek.India continued to dominate possession and territory, with much of the play taking place in Pakistan's half. The hosts went into the first-quarter break with a 2-0 advantage.Harmanpreet then struck again in the 21st minute, this time following a penalty-corner variation. Rajinder Singh took the initial drag-flick, which was saved, but India retained possession and Harmanpreet hammered the rebound past the goalkeeper.The goal took Harmanpreet's tally to five at the 2026 World Cup.Pakistan refused to fold and immediately pulled one back through Hannan Shahid in the 22nd minute. Suraj made the initial save, but Hannan reacted quickest to the rebound and beat the goalkeeper at the second attempt.India restored their three-goal cushion almost immediately. Abhishek produced a superb individual move inside the circle, showing excellent dribbling skills before his effort took a deflection off a Pakistan stick and found the net.Pakistan responded once again. Sufyan Khan converted a penalty corner in the 25th minute, with his drag-flick taking a deflection off Amit Rohidas before ending up in the goal.The second quarter had produced four goals and turned the contest into an increasingly frantic affair. India went into half-time with a 4-2 advantage, but Pakistan had shown they were capable of causing problems.India regained some breathing space early in the second half when they were awarded a penalty stroke after an intentional foul inside the circle. Hardik Singh stepped up and made no mistake, sending the ball into the net to restore India's three-goal advantage.Pakistan continued to push forward, but India defended several dangerous moments effectively. The visitors also earned a penalty corner on the counter-attack, only for India's rushing defenders to put enough pressure on the drag-flicker to force the effort wide.India remained in control heading into the final quarter, although Abhishek came close to adding another before his effort struck the side netting.Pakistan made the perfect start to the final quarter when Hannan Shahid scored his second goal in the 46th minute. Pakistan won possession after Hardik lost the ball in midfield, and Hannan produced a composed finish to cut India's lead to 5-3.India were increasingly forced to defend as Pakistan pressed high in search of another opening. The pressure intensified when Aditya Arjun was shown a yellow card, leaving India with 10 players for the final five minutes.Pakistan won a penalty-corner referral after the ball was adjudged to have hit the shin guard of an Indian defender and continued throwing players forward. India, however, defended resolutely and refused to surrender their two-goal advantage.The result extended India's strong recent dominance over Pakistan and ensured they advanced to the next round of the World Cup, while Pakistan's campaign came to an end.
Article Summary: India beat pakistan 5-3 in their final pool d match of the fih men's hockey world cup. Harmanpreet singh and abhishek scored twice each, while hardik singh converted a penalty stroke. India finished second in pool d with six points from three matches, behind england, who topped the group with nine points.

Article Title: Olivia Culpo flaunts her baby bump in a skin-tight black outfit at 49ers practice while Christian McCaffrey watches from the sidelines
Article Text:
Christian McCaffrey, Olivia Culpo

Olivia Culpo flaunts baby bump in black bodysuit as Christian McCaffrey's injury mystery deepens

A confident display amid contract rumors

that

Christian McCaffrey couldn't practice on Tuesday. His wife didn't need to say a word to steal the moment anyway. Olivia Culpo showed up to the 49ers-Chargers joint session in El Segundo in a skin-tight black bodysuit and leggings, baby bump front and center, standing beside Christian's parents and his brother Max, the Chargers' new running backs coach, while Christian himself watched from the sidelines in street clothes. It was a full family affair. It was also, whether she meant it that way or not, a distraction from the one question the 49ers still won't answer.Culpo, 34 and expecting baby number two with McCaffrey, didn't dress like someone trying to blend into a practice-field crowd. The black sleeveless bodysuit hugged every inch of her growing bump, paired with matching leggings and slides. Simple, but it did exactly what it was supposed to do. She stood side by side with Christian's mom Lisa and his sister-in-law, both in soft neutral tones, which made Olivia's all-black moment pop even harder in the group shot Lisa later posted.This is Culpo's second pregnancy since marrying McCaffrey in 2024. She announced it in early May, just months after their daughter Colette turned one. And she's made a habit this pregnancy of not hiding the bump with beach shots, crop tops, now this.Say what you want about WAG culture, but there's something almost defiant about a woman who keeps showing up in fitted everything while pregnant, like she's decided the bump is the outfit, not something to work around.Christian didn't participate in Tuesday's practice at all. He's been out for days with what Kyle Shanahan is only calling "tightness," and no further explanation, which in NFL speak usually means either something worse than they're letting on, or a very deliberate non-answer.Pro Football Talk floated a theory that it's contract-related, that McCaffrey might be posturing for a pay bump after Bijan Robinson and Jahmyr Gibbs reset the running back market this offseason. Shanahan shot that down publicly. McCaffrey showed up, watched, then posed for family photos afterward, which, fair or not, is exactly the kind of image that fuels more speculation, not less.There's something almost strategic about how visible Olivia was in that moment. Maybe it's nothing; maybe she just wanted family photos with her mother-in-law before a big joint practice. But when your husband is the center of an injury-or-contract guessing game, and you show up looking like, cameras are going to find you regardless.It shifted the day's headlines from "why isn't McCaffrey practicing" to "Olivia Culpo's bump" at least for a news cycle. Whether that's convenient or coincidental is the kind of thing only the McCaffreys know.Either way, the 49ers and Chargers play their second preseason matchup tonight, and McCaffrey is expected to sit again. Culpo, bump and all, will probably be there watching. She usually is.
Article Summary: Olivia culpo showed up to the 49ers-chargers joint session in el segundo in a skin-tight black bodysuit and leggings. She stood beside christian's parents and his brother max, the chargers' new running backs coach, while christian himself watched from the sidelines in street clothes.

Former Chicago Cubs outfielder Jason Heyward is enjoying more time away from baseball after ending his 16-year MLB career earlier this year. The retired All-Star recently shared a relaxed summer moment with his wife, Vedrana, during a yacht outing. Vedrana posted pictures from the trip on her Instagram Story, including a photo of the couple together and another showing her feet in the water. She captioned one post, “Hey babe,” and wrote, “Love you summertime chi,” on another. The outing comes as Heyward begins a new chapter with the Los Angeles Dodgers.Vedrana Heyward gave followers a small look at their time on the water this week. In one Instagram Story, she posed with Jason Heyward while wearing a brown bikini. Another picture showed the view from the yacht as she relaxed with her feet in the water.The posts offered a simple look at the couple's life away from the baseball field. Heyward and Vedrana have been married since March 2021 and have two children, Messi and Slaš. Their family life has mostly stayed away from the spotlight, although Vedrana has supported Heyward throughout his playing career.She has also built work of her own through. The program was launched alongside the Jason Heyward Baseball Academy and focuses on giving young women opportunities through sports, mentorship and leadership.The program is part of the couple's wider effort to support young people in Chicago.Heyward's retirement became official in March 2026.reported that he announced the decision on March 27 after 16 seasons in the majors. He finished his career as a five-time Gold Glove winner, an All-Star and a two-time World Series champion. His first championship came with the Cubs in 2016.Retirement did not keep Jason Heyward away from baseball for long. In May, thereported that the Dodgers brought him back as a special assistant in their front office.Heyward said he wanted to learn more about the business side of baseball. His new duties include taking part in draft meetings, meeting new players and spending time around the team's affiliates. He can also return to the clubhouse and share his experience with players and staff.The role gives Heyward a chance to learn how a team works beyond the field. He told the Los Angeles Times that he hopes to keep learning about scouting, player evaluation, research and analytics as he moves toward the next part of his career.Heyward's final playing season came with the San Diego Padres in 2025. He played 34 games before finishing his 16-year career. Before that, he spent the biggest part of his career with the Cubs from 2016 through 2022. He also played for the Atlanta Braves, St. Louis Cardinals, Dodgers and Houston Astros.For now, Heyward has both baseball and family life keeping him busy. His yacht outing with Vedrana offered a brief glimpse of the quieter side of that new chapter.
